title: Restriction to an affine subspace
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type, let $f:(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n\to\alpha$, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$, and fix $z\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$. The function on $H$ sends each $h\in H$ to $f(h+z)$.
